final: WITH filtered_fees AS (SELECT orderslink, rebtotal, rebrate, feerate FROM fees WHERE rebrate >= 0.0005), order_averages AS (SELECT orderslink, AVG(rebtotal) as avg_rebtotal, AVG(CASE WHEN feerate > 0 THEN rebrate / feerate END) as avg_ratio FROM filtered_fees GROUP BY orderslink), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as mean_ratio FROM order_averages WHERE avg_ratio IS NOT NULL) SELECT oa.orderslink, oa.avg_rebtotal, oa.avg_ratio, CASE WHEN om.mean_ratio IS NOT NULL AND oa.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL THEN oa.avg_ratio / om.mean_ratio END as relative_ratio FROM order_averages oa CROSS JOIN overall_mean om ORDER BY relative_ratio IS NULL, relative_ratio DESC LIMIT 10
